items.quote: Bitte geben Sie uns innerhalb von 15 Werktagen nach dem Briefdatum Bescheid, ob wir das Gutachten erstellen sollen; als Werktage zählen Montag bis Samstag, nicht aber Sonn- und Feiertage.
items.computation: Start: the letter's own date, 20.11.2026 (Friday). The letter explicitly defines the period's start as 'nach dem Briefdatum' and its unit as Werktage = Monday to Saturday, excluding Sundays and public holidays, matching § 187 Abs. 1 BGB (day of the event not counted, counting begins the next day, 21.11.2026). Counting 15 such working days forward from 20.11.2026, skipping the three Sundays that fall in the window (22.11., 29.11., 06.12.2026) and no public holiday falls in that window in either NW or the sender's seat (Hessen), lands on Tuesday, 08.12.2026 (confirmed by the rules engine). That day is itself a business day, so no further weekend/holiday shift is needed.
